items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1968-10-21
items.q: I put, uh, in there, Bruce with Jimmy.

ctx.x: Well, what I was thinking in some ways was that, um, it seems to me that the high register is in some ways more suitable for the music when you're playing with the horns because, Oh yeah, the high register, Because you can hear it better,

you know, it cuts through better. Yeah, sure. But, the solo, and I mean, you know, I put, uh, in there, Bruce with Jimmy. One time I used to put Snagget in it, and, you know, uh, whatever comes to my mind, I played the blues, and, da, da, da, da, da, da, da, you know. Well, I play that song, in the low register, and the baddest, old crowd news. Uh, close the wall with D, I play that, so, in the low register. The low register is the best, you tell the guys to come down, they don't, they don't.
